label: GO step, late in episode, choosing a1 after an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires almost only at GO (99% of mass, none at D2, trace at D1) when the agent is about to choose a1 (98% of mass; policy logit a1-a2 > 8 holds 80%), and mostly when the previous trial was unrewarded (93% of mass). It is strongly gated by episode time: silent before trial ~45 and rising steadily to trial 99 (rate 0.014 at trials 50-59, 0.071 at 90-99). Strongest activations (top quartile, ~100% covered) come after a rare-unrewarded previous trial (a1 -> S2, no reward: the model-based stay case) or runs of unrewarded a1 choices while S1 is good, with low value-head output. Adding prev_state == 2 raises precision to 0.74 (F1 0.69 dev) but drops mass recall to 0.76, so the simpler predicate was recorded. It does not fire on a2 choices, on rewarded-previous GO steps (weak), or on D2. The only FUTURE variable is action at GO, which is the agent own upcoming choice and legitimate; no future reward/transition is used. Precision ~0.53: many late-episode unrewarded a1 GO steps stay silent, so the feature is incompletely captured.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: ep_dec=4 (+3.03), phase=D1 & ep_dec=9 (+2.75), phase=GO & last=a1 S2 u (+2.55), prev_state=2 (+2.29), before=a1 S2 u (+2.13), phase=D1 & value_bin=decile 0 (9 = highest) (+2.09). Lower it: ep_bucket=4 (-8.78), model_act=0 (-5.80), ep_dec=0 (-4.05), phase=GO & ep_dec=0 (-4.03).
